channel.title: JDT Southern Tigers
channel.description: Johor Darul Ta'zim FC (JDT), the Southern Tigers, is Johor's professional football club, playing at Sultan Ibrahim Stadium in Iskandar Puteri, Malaysia.

item.title: How do young Johor players reach the JDT first team?
item.description: JDT's academy runs from Under-12 to Under-23 and feeds JDT II to JDT V. Here is how young Johor players move up, and what parents should know.

item.title: Is a JDT match a good family day out in Johor?
item.description: Sultan Ibrahim Stadium seats 40,000, has prayer rooms and serves local food on big nights. A guide to a JDT matchday with grandparents, parents and kids.

item.title: JDT matchday checklist: tickets, gates and kick-off
item.description: Where to buy official JDT tickets, how to check kick-off times and what to do before you travel to Sultan Ibrahim Stadium. A simple matchday checklist.
